say:1:1641111001:1.text: You don't think I'll get in trouble... right? Technically, it wasn't against the rules.
say:1:1641111001:1.source_cn: 不、不会被发现了吧……应该没有违反规定。
say:1:1641111001:1.male: You don't think I'll get in trouble... right? Technically, it wasn't against the rules.
say:1:1641111001:1.female: You don't think I'll get in trouble... right? Technically, it wasn't against the rules.

say:2:1641111002:1.text: During the swamp island exam, I may have scattered a handful of hazelnut seeds when no one was looking.
say:2:1641111002:1.source_cn: 在沼泽岛上考试的时候，我偷偷从口袋里撒了一把榛子种子。
say:2:1641111002:1.male: During the swamp island exam, I may have scattered a handful of hazelnut seeds when no one was looking.
say:2:1641111002:1.female: During the swamp island exam, I may have scattered a handful of hazelnut seeds when no one was looking.

say:3:1641111003:1.source_cn: 东一颗西一颗，撒得可均匀了。

say:4:1641111004:1.text: People always say I've got good luck. Maybe someday those will grow into a whole grove.
say:4:1641111004:1.source_cn: 大家都说我很幸运，希望这些种子能生长为旺盛的榛木。
say:4:1641111004:1.male: People always say I've got good luck. Maybe someday those will grow into a whole grove.
say:4:1641111004:1.female: People always say I've got good luck. Maybe someday those will grow into a whole grove.

say:5:1641111005:1.text: That way, future students can snack on fresh hazelnuts in the middle of an exam. You're welcome!
say:5:1641111005:1.source_cn: 这样，以后的考生就能吃上美味的榛果啦！
say:5:1641111005:1.male: That way, future students can snack on fresh hazelnuts in the middle of an exam. You're welcome!
say:5:1641111005:1.female: That way, future students can snack on fresh hazelnuts in the middle of an exam. You're welcome!
